title: Day Zero Fastpass: Talent Activation + Interview Calibration
content:
Purpose: Quick, low-friction Day Zero checklist for IC hires + a lightweight interview calibration rubric for recurring interviewers. Intent: get new hires productive within 48–72 hours, reduce first-week friction, and keep interview signal consistent across teams.

Scope: engineering ICs (SWE, infra, applied-ml), but template is adaptable for PM/Design with minor edits. This is a "fastpass" (minimal required items) — complementary to the full 90-day activation playbook.

How to use this doc:
- People Ops creates the Day Zero packet and schedules the mentor pairing before offer acceptance is fully signed (target: 3 business days pre-start).
- Hiring manager confirms role-specific sandbox + first-week objectives by Day -2.
- Buddy/mentor assigned from same pod for the first 30 days; rotate check-ins weekly.

Day Zero Fastpass checklist (minimum required)
-- Pre-start (People Ops / Hiring Manager)
1) IT order submitted (laptop, power adapter, dongles) — include preferred OS image and VPN token requirements.
2) Access requests opened: Okta group, Slack, GDrive (team folder), Jira/Linear project, Container registry read.
3) Internal essentials queued: internal wiki read access, password manager invite, health benefits packet, payroll + tax forms.
4) First-week calendar scaffold sent (intro + 1:1s + code walkthrough + infra orientation).
5) Mentor assigned and briefed with a 5-point guide (see Mentor Quick Guide below).

-- Day 0 (first business day)
1) Welcome email + shared note in #hiring-welcome channel (template below).
2) 30-min manager sync: clarify immediate priorities, expectations, and communication norms.
3) Mentor 1-hour block: environment setup + shadowing plan.
4) Quick wins list: 2 small tasks that touch codebase, CI, and deploy path (goal: push-first-change by EOW).
5) Security & compliance short read: 10–15 min checklist with confirmation in Notion.

Mentor Quick Guide (for first 30 days)
- Day 0: environment setup + explain local dev flow (15–30 min).
- Day 1–7: pair on first small ticket; demo test+deploy path.
- Week 2: owner of a subtask in sprint, mentor shadowing reduced.
- Week 3–4: 1:1 weekly sync focusing on blockers and growth.
- End of 30 days: 30-min calibration with manager + People Ops to confirm next steps.

Quick welcome email template (People Ops)
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — Day 0 logistics for [Name]
Hi [Name],
Welcome! Quick things for Day 0: laptop tracking link, Slack invite, Okta link, first-week calendar, and your mentor [Mentor Name]. Today: setup session at 10:00am PT, manager sync at 11:00am PT. Reach out on Slack if anything blocks you. — Maya (People Ops)

Interview calibration rubric (lightweight; use in recurring interviewer calibration sessions)
Purpose: align interviewers on signals we care about, reduce bias, and keep hiring velocity. This is intentionally short to be used in 15-min pre-interview calibrations.

Core axes (score each 1–4)
1) Problem structuring & approach (1 = missing plan, 4 = clear decomposition + tradeoffs)
2) Technical execution (1 = persistent errors/unable to proceed, 4 = correct & efficient solution)
3) System design sense (for mid/sr roles) (1 = superficial, 4 = thoughtful UX/scale tradeoffs)
4) Communication & collaboration (1 = unclear, 4 = proactive, asks clarifying Qs)
5) Culture fit / operating norms (1 = mismatch, 4 = demonstrated alignment)

Guidance for score buckets
- 1–2: Candidate struggles with fundamentals or cannot reach a minimal acceptable solution. Provide specific examples in feedback.
- 3: Solid candidate with minor gaps; recommend follow-ups or specific role fit notes.
- 4: Strong candidate; provide examples of signal and potential team impact.

Behavioral probe cheat-sheet (3 quick prompts)
- Tell me about a time you shipped something with constraints (time/budget/infra) and how you prioritized tradeoffs.
- Describe a time you had to push back on a stakeholder or change your solution after feedback.
- Run me through a mistake you made in production and how you prevented recurrence.

Interviewer prep (15 min before session)
- Skim resume for role-relevant signals.
- Pick 1–2 targeted probes from behavioral cheat-sheet.
- Align on who will ask what (if panel).
- Confirm grading axis with co-interviewer (quick 2-min sync).

Scoring template (put into post-interview feedback)
- Overall numeric (average of axes): __
- Strengths (bullet):
- Risks / unknowns (bullet):
- Recommendation: no-go | consider | strong-consider | hire

Manager checklist for first-week goals (example deliverables)
- Day 1–3: environment + read access; meet key stakeholders.
- Day 3–7: first code review & small PR merged.
- Week 2: own one bug or feature and present approach in team sync.

Open questions / follow-ups (People Ops)
- Do we want a separate fastpass for managers hiring contractors vs full-time? (TBD)
- Should we ship the 30-day mentor guide as a Google Doc with a weekly checkbox? (Action: Aaron to prototype)
- Can we automate parts of access provisioning based on offer metadata? (Action: Infra team spike — JIRA-HR-4725)

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep this doc light — teams want something they can run from a single page.
- Pull in samples from eng pods who already do rapid 48-hr activations (Lena has 2 examples).
- Try a pilot for hires starting in Jan 2026: 5 hires across infra, serving-runtime, and product-hosted-api.

- Welcome channel template: #hiring-welcome on Slack.
